text: Your AI writes code in minutes. Keeping every version safe shouldn't take longer. This is VibeForge: the artifactory built for vibe coders, with Meta Muse AI reviewing every milestone.
Sign in, create a space for your team, and give each person a role: owner, coder, or reader.
Inside a space, create a project: a timeline of milestones, not commits. Each milestone is your whole app, zipped, scanned, and labelled.
To connect your AI tool, create an API token in your profile. It's shown once, so copy it straight in.
Add VibeForge as an MCP server. In Claude Code it's one command; for Cursor or VS Code, copy the M C P dot JSON snippet. Connected.
Pushing is just asking. Save a milestone: login works. That's milestone one. Dark mode: milestone two. Every push gets the next number, and nothing is ever overwritten.
Every milestone is scanned the moment it lands, for leaked secrets and vulnerable packages, with a plain-words fix and a full bill of materials.

Pattern scanners catch the obvious. For everything else, there's Meta Muse AI. Open settings, and switch on AI review with Meta Muse. Paste your Muse API key. It's sealed on the server and never shown again. Click test connection. Connected, in about a second.

Now pick a model. Muse Spark 1.3 is the latest and recommended, with a one million token context. The Contributor edition is the same model at a tenth of the price, and VibeForge warns you that Meta may train on that code.

You stay in control of what leaves VibeForge. Mask secrets is on by default, so passwords and keys are replaced before any code is sent. Choose how much code to review, and how hard Muse should think.

Now open a milestone and run an AI review. Muse reads the whole app at once and finds what pattern scanners can't: a live payment key hidden in the browser, a database password in the server code, a form that lets anyone add recipes without logging in. You get a score out of one hundred and a grade from A to F, with issues sorted by severity, from critical down to low.

Every issue comes in plain English: what's wrong, why it matters, and the exact file and line. Each one has step-by-step fixes and a ready-made prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot. Or copy one fix-all prompt, paste it into your AI tool, and push the next milestone to see your grade go up.
Broke something? Just tell your AI: restore my folder to milestone one. It saves where you are first, then puts milestone one back. Nothing is lost.
Push. Scan. Review with Meta Muse. Fix. Restore. Every version of everything your AI builds, in one place. VibeForge.
